# Create Doc Page

## Workflow

1. Read 2-3 nearby docs in the target folder.
2. Reuse existing wording and page structure.
3. Keep the page concise.
4. Link related docs instead of copying sections.
5. Add minimal tags when useful, reuse existing tags when sensible.
